rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Elder Exploitation — New Payee with Escalating Payments")`
`comment("Detects account holders 65+ with escalating payments to new payees")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  account_holder_age>=65
  payee_first_seen_days<=30
  payee_in_historical_pattern="false"
| sort 0 account_id, payee_id, payment_date
| streamstats count AS payment_seq, sum(payment_amount) AS running_total,
    first(payment_amount) AS first_payment, last(payment_amount) AS latest_payment
    by account_id, payee_id
| where payment_seq >= 3
| eval escalation_ratio = latest_payment / first_payment
| where escalation_ratio > 1.5
| eval risk_score = case(
    escalation_ratio > 5 AND running_total > 50000, "critical",
    escalation_ratio > 3 OR running_total > 25000, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| stats max(payment_seq) AS payment_count, max(running_total) AS total_amount,
    min(first_payment) AS first_payment, max(latest_payment) AS largest_payment,
    max(escalation_ratio) AS escalation_ratio, values(risk_score) AS risk_score
    by account_id, account_holder_age, payee_id, payee_name
| sort - total_amount
rules.title: DL-0167: Elder Financial Exploitation — New Payee Addition with Escalating Payment Amounts (SPLUNK)
